# Valentine's Day Event (Quest 1)
1. In [Moscovia](wiki:Moscovia), talk to **Pinkamenia** [mosc_in 21/246](navi:mosc_in:21:246) in the tool shop [moscovia 222/176](navi:moscovia:222:176) and help her.
1. She will tell you to bring a +8 [Cake Hat](item:5024) to the Baker Extraordinaire next to her so that you can hunt the [Stolen Cacao](item:7864).
1. Talk to Baker Extraordinaire to get the [Cake Hat (Costume Version)](item:5105).
  1. Note that having a Cake Hat (Costume Version) is entirely optional, provided you can get the Stolen Cacao required.
1. Hunt 15 [Stolen Cacao](item:7864) while wearing the [Cake Hat (Costume Version)](item:5105) (or purchase it from other players) and return back to Pinkamenia.
1. She will reward you with:
1. * 500,000 [Base EXP](wiki:Base_EXP) (750,000 if [VIP](wiki:VIP))
1. * 400,000 [Job EXP](wiki:Job_EXP) (600,000 if [VIP](wiki:VIP))
1. * 1 [Old Purple Box](item:617)
1. * 2 [Rune Strawberry Cake](item:12319)
# Cacao Rewards
After completing the quest you will have the option to trade in [Stolen Cacao](item:7864) for the following:
- 1 Stolen Cacao for a [Well-baked Cookie](item:538)
- 2 Stolen Cacao for a [Chocolate](item:558)
- 5 Stolen Cacao for a [Piece of Cake](item:539)
- 10 Stolen Cacao for a [Chocolate Drink](item:573), a [Hand-made Chocolate](item:559), a [Handmade White Chocolate](item:560) or a [Cookie Bag](item:12130)
- 15 Stolen Cacao for a [Chocolate Mousse Cake](item:12062), a [Cute Strawberry-Choco](item:596) or a [Lovely Choco-Tart](item:597)
- 20 Stolen Cacao for a [Guarana Candy](item:12414) or a [Rune Strawberry Cake](item:12319)
